title: should show the exhausted credits notice with Plans and Refresh actions
verifies: an out-of-credits org sees the exhausted notice, the Plans action and the Refresh action, and no Contact Sales action

title: should show the low credits notice when free credits drop to 20% or less
verifies: a low-balance org sees the low-credits warning with the remaining/limit count and no Refresh action

title: should show Contact Sales instead of Plans for an exhausted contract org
verifies: an exhausted contract org is offered Contact Sales and not the self-serve Plans action

title: should re-check the balance and clear the exhausted notice after refresh
verifies: clicking Refresh re-fetches the balance and transitions the exhausted notice to the low notice

title: should gate a chat turn on paid-usage consent and surface the declined notice on cancel
verifies: a refused chat turn shows the paid-usage consent card with the enable action gated on the checkbox, and cancelling surfaces the declined notice
